claims: The Madison is a neo-Western television drama.
The Madison was created by Taylor Sheridan.
The Madison premiered on Paramount+ on March 14, 2026.
Michelle Pfeiffer stars as Stacy Clyburn in The Madison.
Kurt Russell portrays Preston in The Madison.
Preston is Stacy Clyburn's husband in The Madison.
The Madison follows the wealthy Clyburn family as they relocate from New York City to Montana to rebuild their lives following a profound personal loss.
The Madison is a six-episode series.
The first three episodes of The Madison premiered on March 14, 2026.
The remainder of the episodes of The Madison premiered on March 21, 2026.
The Madison is not a direct Yellowstone spin-off.
The Madison exists as a separate story from the same creator.
